window: the first of the three profiled decapsulations (Section 8), ASIC configuration, from its second busy cycle
method: zero-delay activity of the routed logic from a shadow of the netlist driven by the RTL simulation (scripts/shadow_netlist.py); clock network and register clock pins from OpenSTA's clock analysis; SRAM macros excluded (their Liberty power views are not physical)
registers_note: flip-flops of the routed netlist whose RTL register bit never toggles in the window (24,734 visible in the RTL dump; the remaining unpacked-array registers were counted as toggling)
vcd_time_stretch_note: the system testbench runs a 10 ns clock and the chip's constraints a 40 ns one; the shadow VCD is stretched by this factor before OpenSTA reads it, because OpenSTA counts transitions per second of VCD time (scripts/vcd_shift.py). An earlier version of these results omitted the stretch and so priced the data-dependent power at four times the clock rate. The VCD was regenerated for this correction; without the stretch it reproduces the earlier groups exactly.
